maddeler.e:
يتكأكأ (form IIq)
# يَتَكَأْكَأُ (yatakaʔkaʔu) /ja.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# يُتَكَأْكَأُ (yutakaʔkaʔu) /ju.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# يَتَكَأْكَأَ (yatakaʔkaʔa) /ja.ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
